fact: In August 2020 the CNIAPGE director-general said the government data centre created since 2013 is level 3 by international reference, hosting the administration's data and e-services; no backup site is mentioned.
title: Melanio Ebendeng: para una digitalización total de nuestra Administración Pública, debemos asegurar primero una infraestructura que funcione al 100%
